title: S2 PROMOTION: cheaper consumer upkeep (0.25 -> 0.1) converts to replacement?

identity.note: The probe always ran from the current checkout. A historical arm spec applied here is a settings replay, not a reproduction of its original figure.

preregistration.hypothesis: S2 screen: basal 0.1 read C101 B/D 1.05 (41002) and C87 B/D 1.03 (41005) where base reads C0 — the shared-helper era may let upkeep discounts reach the gates they previously missed. Full-panel test.
preregistration.prediction: cons > 0 on at least 12/18 AND prod > 0 on at least 12/18 seeds at tick 6000 (both machine). Coexistence NOT predicted.
preregistration.falsification: FALSIFIED if cons = 0 on 7 or more of 18: cheaper upkeep does not convert at panel scale — the screen read was seed luck. No further upkeep descent in this line.
preregistration.notPredicted: Coexistence rates, capture shares, B/D distributions (descriptive).
